book.name: Revelation
book.title: Revelation Jesus-el ileyel, nthakenharl irreyneyenh arrwekel

content: Ikwer-theyan atha antyerl ingwer-anem arew altyerr-angkwarr, irrwerl-theyarl atwarrenhey-alpenh arawerrng rlterrk-akert. Ran artewenty amparrkenh, lyenenty arrtyernew apmer arrpanenh-itwew ahern-itwew.

content.text: Akngerr apmer arrpanenh-areny alhenh apmer yanh-warl,
Atyetyart apmer arrpanenh-areny alhenh apmer yanh-warl,
Ingwer-rneman apmer arrpanenh-areny tharlemeley-angker rernem alhenh apmer yanh-warl,

content: Atha awew ingwerentyak-anem, irrwerl-theyarl arlkenty alakenh:

content.text: Angkep atweyneyew artewenty innga apmwa yanh-rnem!
Rernem angkenh, ‘Anantherr atyetyart aneyel akngerrew apmer arrpanenhel.
Kel arrantherran renh-rnem-anem awakelhemel akertemwengk amperrgeleyew!
Tangkemel rernem angkenty-penh Akngeyel renh-rnem anamerl-antey court-em-elemel artewenty atweyenh arawerrng ilkwa ikwerenh-akertel.

content: Tawen yanhan amperl-aneyenhel, kwert akngerr arlwa anerl-aneyenh ikwer-they. Ingkerrenhelan areyenh. Atyetyart apmer arrpanenh-areny-rnem rerneman apmer yanh-warl alhenh, ilek-ilek apmwa mpwareyew. Rernemap apmwangkwarr ayntenh ingwer-rnem-then apmer ikwer-areny-rnem-itwew – apwert akngerr-akert, arnkwa akngerr-akert, ilek-ilek mwerr-angker-akert. Rernemap kwert areyenh, artnemel artewenty arrangkeyenh apmer ikwerew, atyetyart yanh-rnem.
Arleng-they rernem apmwa yanh arerl-aneyenh. Rernemap atererreyenh, nthakenh arrer-apeny alhey-angenh, Akngeyelarl renh-rnem arrtyewerr arrpemarl. Artewenty inngey rernem artneyenh alakenh angkemel:

content.text: Artwa army-areny akngerrelan tawen renh arntarnt-arenh!
Aleyan Akngeyel anamerl-antey tawen renh ywerrelheleyenh-anem!”

content: “Tharlemeley-angker-rnem rernem-then arrangkeyenh tawen ikwerew arrpemarl, iney-angker-rneman ingkerr-anemarl ipma aneyel. Nthakenh man iney-angenh-anem, arrangkw-anem.

Rernemap apateyelpeyenh, ayernerr-aynteyenh-anem, ‘Angwenhel-aneman anewantherr-itwew gold, thilp, man ilek-ilek mwerr-angker-then ineyenh? Angwenhel-anem anewantherr-itwew ineyenhan arnkwa mwerr-angker, arwerl mwerr-angker intenty-then? Angwenhel-anem anewantherr-itwew ineyenhan ilek-ilek arwerl-penh, apwert-penh, ayen-penh-akerr?

Angwenhel-anem anewantherr-itwew ineyenhan ilek-ilek mwerr intenty alyerremwey-then, ngkwarl wayn, anter olive, pelaw-akerr? Angwenhel-anem anewantherr-itwew ineyenhan pwelek-rnem, yep-yep-rnem, nantew-rnem, pakey-akerr? Angwenhel-anem anewantherr-itwew ineyenhan irrepern-rnem, anantherrarl pwerep-anthenh, arwa arrangkwew warrkerreyew? Nthakenh ingwerentyel ilek-ilek iney-angenh-anem anewantherr-itwew, arrangkw-anem!’ Alakenh iterr-aynteyenh tharlemeley-angker yanh-rnem.

Rernemap angkeyenh alakenh, ‘Tawen Babylon-ay! Arrangkw-anem! Ngan apmer ilkwetangkwel anenh. Aleyanap ilek-ilek mwerr-angker ngkwenh-rnem arrangkw-anem. Nga ilek-ilekek ahenty anenh, rernemap arrangkw-arem. Man ngkwenh arrangkw-anem irrew. Nthakenh inenhey-alpey-angenh, arrangkw.’ Alakenh-anyem rernem angkerl-aneyenh.

Rernemap man akngerr innga inenh, apmer ikwer-warlarl alhenh, ilek-ilek tharlemel-aynteyew. Arleng-they rernem arerl-aneyenh. Rernemap atererreyenh, nthakenh arrer-apeny alhey-angenh, Akngeyel renh-rnem arrtyewerr arrpemarl. Rernemap artneyenh artewenty inngey,

content.text: Arlkitwew ilek-ilek gold-penh arrernew apwert mwerr-angker-rnem-then!

content: “Akngerr ingwer-rneman kwaty alayel artarnpenhew rtnwangkwarr, man ineyew apmer arrpanenhel. Rernemap arleng-they arerl-aneyenh warrkenh ikwer-rnem-wenh-thenel.

Kwert rernem arerl-aneyenh, arlwar anerl-aneyenh rwa ilkwa inngethey apmer ikwer-itwew. Rernemap angkerrerl-aneyenh alakenh, ‘Tawen ingwer-rneman tawen nhanyem-weny. Tawen nhenhan ilkwa ingwer-rnem-angkwarrarl.’
Rernemap akapwert-warl ahern arrerneyenh, rernemarl amperrngerreyenh apmer yanh-areny-rnemew, artewenty inngey artneyenh alakenh angkemel:

content.text: Akngerr ingwer-rneman apmer ikwer-warl alhenh, kwaty alayel artarnpenhemel rtnwangkwarr,
ilek-ilek tharlemeleyew, man inaynteyew tawen ikwer-areny-rnem-they.
Irrwerl-areny-rnem arrantherran inkwerelhenh-arey-anem! Apmer apmwa yanh arrangkw-anem!
Inkwerelhenh-arey-anem Akngey-wenh-rnemay! Inkwerelhenh-arey-anem kwertengerl Jesus-wenh-rnemay! Inkwerelhenh-arey-anem artwa angkakert Akngey-wenh-rnemay!
Babylon areny-rnemelan arrenhantherrenh atwenh, pwarrk ilkwa anthemel.
Aleyanap Akngeyel renh-rnem angkep atwew irrkaty-angkwarr.”

content: Ikwer-penhan antyerl ilkwel apwert ilkwa irrwerlelew, kwaty alay-warl-anem iwew. Rap angkew:

content.text: “Athap apwert ilkwa iwew kwaty alay-warl, raw ywerrey-alhewarl.
Kel alakenh Akngeyel tawen renh Babylon ahern-warl iweyenh,
Angwenhel arreyn mwerr-angker aylelhey-angenh-anem apmer ikwer-itwew, arrangkw-anem.
Angwenhel ampwal mwerr-angker-rnem nthakenh mpwarey-angenh-anem ikwer-itwew.
Apmer ikwer-areny-rnem tharlemeley-angker-rnem rernem tyak innga anenh.
Akngerr ingwer-rneman apmer arrpanenh-areny-rnem awelhenh ikwer-rnemew.
Tawen Babylon-areny-rnemel ipmew renh-rnem atwenh artwa angkakert Akngey-wenh-rnem.
Akngey-wenh-rnem ingkerrenh, akngerr ingwer-rnem-then rernem ipmew atwenh.
Alakenh-anyem Akngeyel tawen Babylon ywerrelhelew-anem ikwer-areny-rnem-then.”
